name: cg_trending_coins
description:
Trending search items on CoinGecko over the last 24 hours (search/trending): coins, plus NFTs and categories.
Returns {coins: [{item: {id, name, symbol, market_cap_rank, price_btc, score, ...}}], nfts: [...], categories: [...]}.
Inputs: none.
Popularity by searches, not price movement; for 24h movers see cg_top_gainers and cg_top_losers.
